contract_interface: --contract JSON object or list overrides DEFAULT. pop_formula requires validated pq/*.csv.pop_path.csv. pq_operation_overlap=true rejected. commit_owner_ii governs reset and round-robin visits; commit_issue_ii distinct from commit_latency. pop/push_reaccept_gap separates retire and next operation start. response_latency models finite depth4 PQ response FIFOs. --experiment selects outputs and evidence.
cycle_sensitivity_note: 25% and 35% are not confidence intervals. Historical actual-denominator 25.6% underprediction correction is 1/(1-.256)=1.344086; 25% alone does not cover it.
